verification.environment: Mounted React/jsdom plus real useCoder and MCP validator; synthetic callbacks; no live mutations.

findings.title: Config doctor can write to a different project using a stale preview and confirmation
findings.body:
Config doctor's preview and Confirm write state survive switching projects. The user can inspect A's generated files and then confirm a write that targets B.

### Reproduction
1. Open Memory for project A and click Config doctor Preview.
2. Click Write AGENTS.md once to arm Confirm write.
3. Switch to a thread/project B while remaining on Memory.
4. A's preview remains visible, including its content, and Confirm write remains armed.
5. Click Confirm write: the callback receives `{projectId:"b"}`.

Reproduced by mounting the real MemoryTab and changing project props without a key, matching [AgentsPanel's call site](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/AgentsPanel.tsx#L3247). No actual files were written. Runnable assertion: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-editor-actions-evidence.mjs`.

### Cause
[ConfigDoctorCard](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/MemoryTab.tsx#L250) keeps preview/confirmWrite across projectId changes; loadLint only resets error/wrote. Async results check mounted only, not project identity. onWrite reads the current projectId. [services.writeAgentConfig](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/electron/services.js#L4827) regenerates and writes the current project's files. Thus this is a wrong-target confirmation, not a claim that A's preview bytes are copied into B.

### Acceptance
- Project changes invalidate preview, confirmation and project-specific status before writing is available.
- Pending lint/preview/write completion for A cannot populate B's doctor state.
- Bind the visible target, preview and confirmation to one project identity; show the project in write confirmation.
- Confirming A's preview must never dispatch a write for B. Require a fresh B confirmation after switching.
- Cover preview A→B, armed confirmation A→B, deferred preview A resolving after B, and A→B→A.
- Keep actual completed writes recorded without repainting a different project.

### Duplicate check
#1123 is Memory browsing/layout and loading; this is the separate destructive config-file action's authorization/target state. #179 is server project-key canonicalization. #796 changed generated content. #1131 is Planboard task completion; different owner and mutation.

Audited source and default-branch MemoryTab blobs matched. Parent audit #1135.

findings.title: Workflow editor silently discards drafts and lets an old save overwrite a reopened editor
findings.body:
Manage workflows loses unsaved text when another template is selected. It also allows closing during a pending save, then a late completion can replace a newer draft after reopening.

### Reproduced with the real WorkflowsModal
- Edit A's name, select B, select A: A's original name returns and the edit is lost with no discard decision.
- Start saving A with a deferred response. Footer Cancel is disabled, but header Close works.
- Reopen the modal, select B and type a new draft.
- Resolve A's old save: the editor switches to saved A and B's new text disappears.

Runnable assertions: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-editor-actions-evidence.mjs`. Synthetic callbacks, no real template mutations.

### Cause and bounded fix
[pickTemplate/startNew](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/WorkflowsModal.tsx#L135) replace the sole draft. [save/removeSelected](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/WorkflowsModal.tsx#L193) apply results to whichever editor session is now open. Opening resets saving=false, while header Close, Escape and backdrop close bypass the pending guard. App keeps the modal component mounted when closed, so old callbacks remain live.

Preserve dirty edits per template/session or require an explicit discard choice. Tie completion updates to the initiating editor session. Use consistent close behavior for header, Escape, backdrop and footer; no need for a global draft framework.

### Acceptance
- Switching template/New/closing never silently destroys a dirty name, instruction or phase edit.
- Pending save/delete cannot overwrite selection or drafts in a later modal session.
- Header Close, Escape, backdrop and footer obey one pending/dirty policy.
- A save/delete can finish on the host without forcing unrelated later editor state to reset.
- Verify A→B→A dirty navigation and deferred save→close→reopen→edit B→resolve A; include failed save and delete.
- Preserve builtin-copy behavior and accessible focus when discard confirmation is used.

### Duplicate check
#921 is Composer drafts, #935 thread notes, #926 queue edits. #729 changes Workflows chrome only; #164/#275 add workflow products. None owns this modal's draft/session lifetime. The separate workflow refresh issue concerns acknowledged writes being incorrectly reported as failures.

WorkflowsModal matched default-branch blob. Parent audit #1135.

findings.title: Successful workflow saves are reported as failures when refresh rejects, causing duplicates on retry
findings.body:
A workflow can be saved successfully while the editor reports failure because the subsequent list refresh fails. Retrying Save creates another template because the editor never receives the first saved ID.

### Reproduction
Mounted the real WorkflowsModal with real useCoder and a fake host:
1. Open a new unsaved workflow.
2. workflows.save commits a template and resolves with its new ID.
3. The following workflows.list rejects.
4. The editor shows the refresh error and stays in new-template mode.
5. Retry Save: a second id-less create is sent, yielding two IDs for the same draft.

Runnable assertion: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-editor-actions-evidence.mjs`. The fake host stores both created rows in memory; no live store mutation. The production [Store.saveTemplate](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/electron/store.js#L3288) indeed creates a UUID for each id-less save and each builtin-copy save, so this is not an artifact of idempotent fixture assumptions.

### Cause and smallest fix
[useCoder.saveWorkflow](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/useCoder.ts#L1637) awaits refreshWorkflows before returning an acknowledged saved result. A refresh rejection masks success. The caller's saved-ID adoption never runs. removeWorkflow uses the same mutation-then-refresh error coupling.

Treat mutation completion and list refresh as separate outcomes. Adopt the authoritative returned template immediately, then refresh/reconcile without converting a known successful mutation into a failed save. Report a failed refresh separately and retry the read, not the acknowledged write. Apply the same truthfulness to removal.

### Acceptance
- Successful new/builtin-copy saves adopt the returned ID even if workflows.list fails.
- Subsequent Save updates the saved copy instead of creating another.
- The UI clearly distinguishes save failure from saved-but-refresh-failed.
- True mutation failure preserves the draft and permits a deliberate retry.
- Successful removal remains represented as removed when its follow-up list refresh fails.
- Add hook+modal coverage for acknowledged save→failed refresh→retry, including builtin copies.
- No automatic mutation replay after an ambiguous timeout; this reproduction specifically has a known successful save response.

### Duplicate check
#941 is duplicate automation creation while Add is pending. #928 is reconnect write coalescing. This is sequential workflow retry after a successful response hidden by a failed read. Separate from the editor-session lifetime issue: this reproduces without closing or switching templates.

Parent audit #1135. Audited at 6c7a6fb.

findings.title: Local MCP setup corrupts quoted paths and arguments containing spaces
findings.body:
Skills → MCP → Local command cannot correctly represent an argument containing spaces. It silently saves malformed argv, so a valid local server command may not start.

### Reproduction
Enter command `node` and arguments:
```text
"/tmp/My Tools/server.mjs" --label "hello world"
```
Click Add local server. The real SkillsTab passes:
```json
["\"/tmp/My","Tools/server.mjs\"","--label","\"hello","world\""]
```
instead of three arguments with the script path and label intact. The real backend validateMcpServers accepts this array unchanged.

Runnable assertion: `node --import=./test/support/disable-grok-mcp.mjs --import=./test/support/render.mjs --experimental-strip-types docs/issue-drafts/2026-09-08-editor-actions-evidence.mjs`. No command was launched and no live MCP settings were written.

### Cause and smallest useful UI improvement
[handleAddLocalMcp](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/src/components/SkillsTab.tsx#L353) uses split(/\\s+/), trims and drops empty values. [mcp.parseArgs](https://github.com/currentbits/solenta/blob/6c7a6fbebb066942f7f5702084f1af1e0730319d/electron/mcp.js#L261) correctly treats the supplied array as literal argv; it cannot reconstruct user intent. The form gives no parsing-format explanation. JSON import already supports explicit argument arrays.

Prefer a simple explicit argv editor (one native field per argument, or a clearly labelled JSON array using the existing parser) that preserves spaces, quotes, backslashes and empty arguments. If retaining a command-line string, use a well-defined existing tokenizer and validate malformed quoting. Do not run the value through a shell to fix tokenization.

### Acceptance
- A script path with spaces and an argument value with spaces each reach saveMcpServer as one exact array element.
- Literal quotes, backslashes, Unicode and empty argument values round-trip under the documented input format.
- Invalid input produces a local error and retains the draft.
- Command and args remain separate; shell expansion/substitution is not introduced.
- Existing trust/enable rules and backend validation remain intact.
- Verify the form→backend argument array and preserve working JSON import.

### Duplicate check
#1125 reorganizes the Skills library and MCP setup; this is a concrete manual setup correctness bug independent of that layout. #984 covers harness import; #305 is install-time scanning. It is not a provider capability or shell-execution feature.

SkillsTab matched default-branch blob. Parent audit #1135.
